reviews.text: [b] as it stands, for its target audience? cant recommend esp. at its price-tag. [/b] The game and idea is fantastic, in fact, if it weren't for how incredibly short the runs were it'd be a recommendation. But on my 3rd or 4th run as warrior I focused on unicorns/pegasus and all I got to was unicorns. There literally ins't enough game time to get to some of the end game recipes. I wanted to make pegasus which is a 3 step crafting recipe. with each step having some of its own complications: Step 1: Have rectangles and trapezoids or cut squares and triangles into rectangles and trapezoids, then prepare pieces into horses - you now have horses. (note: cutting is an entire extra step of its own that require a research point, horse can be unlocked as a basic unit - so you can for example: unlock horses, but not be able to use them, from the start) Step 2: Mix green and red ink to make yellow (there is no 'yellow' ink - you have to mix a primary (red) and secondary (green) to make... a primary colour (yellow)), add ink to triangles, add now yellow dyed triangles to horses - you now have unicorns. Step 3: Have semi circles or cut circles (at least by this point you've unlocked the tech to cut stuff), add them to your... oh wait, the games over, you won. And even if you hadn't won, you wouldn't have the time to make an army or tier 3 unicorns anyway. Not because time is limited (you can pause and build), but because resources are limited and by the time you are end game reaching an tier 3, A grade unit is impossible. The game makes itself more difficult as you play - but none of that increases your resources, enemies just get more beefy. So it's difficult to reach end-game units given the game length, which makes them almost pointless because I imagine eventually I'll reach a difficulty level where I need tier 3 grade A units, but I wont have any because each game doesn't run long enough. The game needs a 4th step to allow for actually being able to fully see and or use the tech tree. There are a lot of improvements this game needs - as it stands, for its target audience? cant recommend esp. at its price-tag.

I might recommend this in version 1.0, but right now in Early Access it's too difficult to set up a factory to make enough "Heroes" of different varieties if you also want to level them up. The RNG with the tech tree, and your choices of Heroes and upgrades to them, will make or break your runs, and the actual fights versus the enemies are a nice visual, but lacks impact. After you unlock the perk "no direct influence" (or something) as the starter Master, all you can do is speed through the battle and hope you win - which I prefer to having to click with my mouse with little impact. It's an Auto-Battler where you're not sure how to win the battle outside of some hints written on each boss or mini-boss. All in all, the games has a lot of information that is hard to find, hard to understand at times, and some translation errors (such as "technology tree" which is like branches of tech; the tech tree is ALL technology, come on) that don't fit well in the English localisation. While the game is fun to play, there's too much RNG.

！直接说结论：千万别买！！！！！！！！DO NOT BUY!!!!!!! 看得出制作组想法是好的，但是做的不怎么样。想避坑的可以直接撤了，还想入的话可以往下看。 先说最核心的工厂建造部分，基本上模式照搬的异形工厂但是又没学明白。恰好最近异形工厂2发布，两相对比之下真是云泥之别阿。玩过异形工厂以及幸福工厂等等工厂类游戏的玩家应该都能理解我的难受的点，所以我不理解那些吹的人还真有吹工厂建造部分的阿，不知道是没玩过别的工厂类游戏还是水军。制作组我请问了，你们真的玩过自己的游戏吗，就一个平面生产线不能互相交叉，翻越隧道还限制死了长短不能多不能少。传送带分离器和合并器不对称，导致很多东西很难处理。 再说有人提到过的，肉鸽元素。我又想请问了，制作组您真的玩过自己玩的游戏吗？您这个肉鸽元素带来的正反馈远远不能满足我耗时耗力搭建完成的生产线而完成的防守，就更不用提什么build了。我辛辛苦苦打完一场战斗，结果你给我三个我全造不了的兵种？？？ 我本来是抱着一个肉鸽+工厂建造爱好者的双重身份入手的贵游，结果你们两个核心要素哪个也没做好，这两个要素别说相辅相成了，完全就是相互掣肘。 最后提一下最搞笑的限时系统，这个系统存在的意义完全不明，如果是自走棋类游戏你限制实践做准备还则罢了，但是你这个准备是工厂建造啊！限时？？？？您但凡了解过一点工厂建造类游戏您就会知道几乎没有任何一个人是能快速熟悉机制并且拉好生产线的，这又不是rts游戏好叭！有人说了，阿有难度选项，还难度？？就你这个破系统还指望人玩个二周目三周目？？？？？又有人说了，阿设置里能设置暂停也可以拉产线。是，暂停是能拉产线，但是tm的水晶生产也暂停了阿！！？？在这里向还没被坑的路过玩家们补充说明一下，是的这个游戏拉产线要消耗的不是可以采集的资源而是完全固定生产速度的水晶。你在一回合内不能通过任何手段提高水晶的生产效率导致你在暂停拉产线的时候还得考虑每一个传送带会不会把水晶消耗完。因为你一旦用完水晶产线还没拉好，那么对不起，要不你自己全都推翻了重来，要么取消暂停跟时间玩命。啊对了，后面解锁的什么高级传送带和高级矿山高级生产者都需要大量的成倍增长的水晶，笑死一开始一周目费劲巴拉的能玩明白就不错了。 最后再提一句这个搞笑的引导，貌似引导内容很多，实则少得可怜，很多东西你要是不看网上的攻略全靠自己摸索需要超级大量的时间，而你一个不小心，ops，不好意思，超过退款时间了。人家隔壁异形工厂2怕你玩不明白，每出一个新东西手把手教你怎么操作，完了还把大量的补充说明写在游戏内的百科里方便你随时查看，而贵游这点破东西也不好意思做个游戏内百科哈。最后，我刚刚又看到制作组说什么“反响超出预期”，笑死，雀实超出预期了，超出预期的烂。最后奉劝所有看到这里的路过的人，千万千避坑，如果你是看到B站或者哪里的推广来的，有信不过而看到我这篇评测的，千万千万别买，有这个钱买隔壁异形工厂2爽玩香的多。

I keep coming back to the game, so that bodes well. The initial promise is there, and the idea of creating units that are immediately used in a battle in a factory management style game is fun! But the actual application of it is lacking at the moment. It does not feel like the devs even test their game. I also feel like the playerbase has been pretty vocal about a few requests but have gone unanswered/unacknowledged. At the moment, I don't recommend the game. There's the potential for this to turn into a charmingly designed gem of a game. But it feels like the devs keep scuffing up the shine I saw in it.

I really like the concept of this game. I enjoy the game. But I kept feeling really unsatisfied, and it took me a while to figure out exactly why. Using a factory to create units that can defend a base sounds really fun! I think it's a great concept for a game. But something about how it's implemented feels lacking... tedious and unsatisfactory. Here are the problems I feel like I had: The game has rogue-lite mechanics where you start a run, go through 3 maps with 3 bosses, and it's done. During this, you create a factory. The factory you create always feels like it could be better, but you'll never be able to finish. You're limited on resources, which is fine, but you have to be picky about which units you create. So in any given run, you often choose between 3-5 units of the few dozen available, and only create an optimized factory to create those units. Then when you finish the run, your entire factory is wiped. Reduced to a memory that you can only look at in your run history. Any optimizations you made, any units you created, any "I almost had enough resources to create the next unit tier" -- gone. In the factory creation itself, it feels more like a constant optimization of numbers than anything else. And if it's not numbers, then it's conveyor belt spaghetti. As you progress through a run, the numbers constantly change. First it's 2 mining units for 4 crafters. Then you upgrade some, and now it's 2 mining units for 5 crafters, and you have to redo all of your conveyor belts if you want to utilize that optimization. Then you upgrade it again and now it's 2 mining units for 6 crafters! A completely different conveyor belt balancing is required! If I only had to do this a few times, that's fine. But I had to go through this loop every run. I can't pre-optimize because you can't even afford to build 6 crafters at the beginning. And there's no just adding crafters to the end of a line of them.... Which brings me to my next problem. The majority of the factory building is just conveyor belt spaghetti. It's so designed into the game that not only are there upgrades to splitters, joiners, underground belts, etc... But I also feel the need to get at least 1-3 every run to just not feel annoyed at the whole factory. Which then causes me to not even try picking some of the new/unknown upgrades. But back to the belts... you have to criss-cross them any time you have a different number of sources than sinks, which is pretty much always. This combined with the constant source-sink ratio changes, and the factory being restarted every run, with no blueprints, copy/paste, or even the same set of tools every run... it ends up feeling tedious, like you're wasting all your time on the wrong thing. Also, the battles have ended up feeling like a miniscule part of the game. Sure, the goal is there. But I mostly just want to skip it, and I mostly only look forward to the battles because it will come with the next mini-boost to my resources to continue more factory. I ended up just fast-forwarding through them and barely caring. Also, as the game currently is, I got multiple upgrades where I didn't have any other options available for my major upgrade, and it was just completely useless and irrelevant to what I was building. Like giving me a boost to half-squares when I have no units that even use half-squares. And it feels like half of the upgrades are like this. It's just disappointing. I feel like there must be some way to change the game to fix this, but it feels like it would need to be a significant overhaul at this point.

肉鸽元素和工厂元素的结合很有趣，但游戏整体还是很难让人玩下去 首先是平衡问题，部分boss的机制太强，或者说对策性太强。基本上就要根据即将遇到的boss去控制要造的兵种，然后部分兵种太弱，或者兵种没得到升级就是纯鸡肋 然后这个时停改产线是个成就的问题，基本是，3分钟准备时间，产线没怎么改就倒计时结束了，基本没有太多的发育时间，把时停关了有点难以想象手速要多快，构思要多快才能完成挑战 然后就是挑战流程太短，当一个很帅的版图规划刚规划得差不多的时候，游戏就戛然而止了，目前也没有无尽挑战，以及，一把游戏难以存在多个流派同步，感觉还是玩起来挺难受的，而且没抽到想玩的流派的配方基本是就没法打。 当然不排除我比较菜，但确实体验并没有特别好

1.流程太短，大部分游戏到结束都出不来三阶兵种（甚至是不需要出，现在许多三阶兵种真弱），游戏设计的高阶兵种是鸡肋或者说不让玩家用大量高阶兵种那设计出来有什么意义？ 2.没有蓝图，一个肉鸽游戏每次开局都要要重复一次基础兵种的摆放。思考了一个很帅的版图规划刚规划得差不多的时候，游戏就戛然而止，这不就是刚坐上马桶想释放一下，突然地震让你憋回去一样难受。 3.科技不平衡，部分科技强度就是碾压其他，举个例子一格合并与分流的科技树，资源就是比没有这个科技要多出接近1/3，这还是不算空间节约的收益。高级画布甚至比甜点、小精灵、墨水吃满的画布还强上一些那我点这些科技有什么用？ 4.兵种不平衡，战士走盾系甚至过不了4火（我骑士2星满血进黑龙直接被喷死）。6火走隔壁弓箭，龙还没很喷第二口就被打死了，我们重弩太有强度了。独角兽？这玩意需要的素材那么抽象他的强度对得起他需要的材料么？
画布升级要随机很恶心，交叉分拣器都得看运气，数值做的稀烂，3级产物基础速率0.125/s，在没有画布升级的情况下得开8条产线还是3合1，需要24条2级产物入口，还不给基础的分拣器弯弯绕绕恶心的一批. 给两个建议，画布和分拣器的科技树可以默认拥有，1级到2级中间的生产效率可以砍半后面的看情况别砍了，最终产物慢的要死，非得加倍拉产线做一万个画布才舒服吗 蹲一手要是改了就改好评

Yes, it is indeed fun the first time playing it. But i cant recommend it, because its the same friggin lazy design done in the past 20 years of game development. - Design a bunch of interesting abilities - throw them all together indiscriminately into 1 pool - roll a dice and pick one to give the player afterthought: - design a bunch of thematic but utter useless or very very situational abilities - throw them all together into the pool - make progression unlocking all those abilities Its done for more than 20 years and for more than 20 years player complain about rng. - getting at start of run nothing that you could actually make use of for the first 3rd of the run - getting nothing but stuff that is only realy useable at the very end or past the run (endless) - getting nothing but the crap choices and "padding" (to "round ou" the pool, to increase pool size) abilities - getting heros right at start offered, that you cant build no matter what, until at least 2nd 3rd of run - the more you unlock, the more frustrating the game becomes. because the amount of crappy abilities or very very situational ones increases. decresing your chance of pulling usefull ones. I personally think this kind of game shouldnt be promoted. If you look arround right now, there are several (!) games that came out "recently", that do teh exact same crap. Its nothing new, its oldoldold dead horse beating old justified complains of players.
Its ok, but lacks a little Replayability.

I really wish I could give this a positive rating, but there are just too many issues. This game idea is great, and I had a lot of fun for about two hours. Once past the initial impressions, the cracks started to show, and some are significant. Reading the forums and previous reviews, I see a lot of the same concerns have been raised often for 7-8 months, but remain untouched. It feels like a game that is 80% complete, but no one wants to push across the finish line. Work needs to be done on the rewards that are offered between battles - specifically there should be some basics that are always offered or at least get a increased chance of offer. As an example, in my second game I played as the spell slinger master that was unlocked. The idea is this master is more direct in combat with spells, and the minions are a lesser focus. Unfortunately I got over halfway into Act 2 before a spell was offered that used components available to me. That spell wasn't even very good, I just took it because I wanted to have one rather than passively watching the battles. Even to get that spell I had to open a new area of the map for the resource required, this was only possible because my reward also included the option to open a new map region. I spent two reward options to get my first spell as the spell focused master over halfway through the run. To make it worse, the map section only had one small ink spot of the needed color, so I could barely produce even after that work. Meanwhile I have three areas of research opened to me that revolve around moving ink, and I have no use for ink. Reward offers are just too random overall. A lot of the choices you have to make are with the hope that you will later get another random offer to take advantage of it, but that might not come. For example if a reward includes a hero statue; this device generates that hero at a slow rate but does not require resources. The heroes it generates can't be sent directly to the portal for battle, they are only useful if that hero is a component of another hero recipe.. and you have no way to know if you will ever get offered a hero recipe that uses it. So you take the reward with the hope that it will be useful, but random chance says you may never use it, and even if you do, the production rate on the statue is so low it's not of much value anyway. Because of these issues and the overall pacing of the game, the 'best' strategy is just to stick with the basic heroes and don't even bother going for higher tier heroes. Those higher tier heroes often require previous rewards to be used at all, and if you happen to get that, their production is so convoluted that you won't be able to produce many before the game ends. I hope they will continue to develop this, it is a great idea and it's fun when the random offers line up to allow you to experiment - but that doesn't happen often.

I've played this game for a couple of days now and it feels great. I love the concept of the game but as you will see on some of the other negative reviews, there are a handful of mechanics that make or break your run and desperately need patch balancing. PROS: - Fun and relatively simple factory mechanics combo up nicely with the rogue-like aspect. once you figure out the optimal layouts for your factory, incorporating new tech keeps things varied and challenging. - Plenty of build combinations to try, each with their own strategic use and style. - Points based research tree allows you to micromanage the perks you need over others you don't. CONS: - RNG is absolutely terrible and can ruin a run with nothing you can do about it. - Unit unlocks are from a random selection and sometime offer no chance for progression or preference. (Several times i was given upgrades to existing units that i couldn't fully utilise, or new units i had no need or use for in my tech tree.) - Units are derpy and often under-powered even when mass produced to multiple stars. (I had a run where i only had humans and horses given to me with no pikemen appearing in rewards. Even with 2 star, 0.3/sec production on both i got swarmed and most units auto-pathed to enemies on the edge of the map instead of immediate danger!) - Technology upgrades are a choice between 2 random tech branches, some of which are completely useless and irrelevant to your build. - Some of these said tech branches are extremely hard to implement efficiently and even more so in late game where space is critical. For example, Ink engines are hard to utilise being 1 per canvas required and plumbing them in between a mass conveyor system is nigh impossible without completely overhauling your line. The same can be said of minion snacks. - Many tech perks emulate the same function as each other with little standalone value. (engine/snacks/S.minions = production speed. Smart canvas>super on a typical run. Multi cutters/canvas are seldom useful for 90% of production.) - Motif sources are few and quickly at full capacity, which is odd for a game that requires continuous expansion. There are many factors that can lead to an unwinnable scenario unless you want to leave it to chance and likely end up repeating previous runs. This lack of player influence can become stale and tedious when you have to do multiple play-throughs to hopefully find the load-out you want and make progress. Useless and unwanted upgrades cause more frustration than they solve. Until the mechanics of this game are overhauled to allow for more player preference and certain features such as pipe pathing and conveyor bridging are improved & implemented as a standard, instead of left to luck, I will have to give this game a negative rating. Some are these things a but a few of many i cannot fit on this comment but balancing is a major issue right now. I hope the developers see this as constructive criticism and work to improve things instead of cashing out. I things get ironed out I will happily withdraw this review.

游戏是好游戏，优化好了可以作为下一个杀时间利器了。但是目前还是可以再等等，留个差评希望引起制作组的注意 提几个亟待优化的Life Quality更新 1.蓝图蓝图蓝图。制作组能想象到每局重开都要重新规划有多蛋疼吗 2.对局中的兵种/配件解锁。我可以接受需要生产XX个长枪后解锁枪兵这种设定，但是完全接受不了解锁兵种还需要对战后看脸去重Roll的这种鬼机制。前期打顺风解锁了几个基础兵种等着连携的，结果卡在一个两个方块就能合成的手里剑配件卡到死，游戏热情瞬间就消退了 3.英雄石像是好机制，本身是为了简化生产线及提高生产效率的。既然有都有了，不如大胆点，未来开放一下石像升级，提升一下石像自动产出的速度，没必要和玩家的爽点对着来，你说是吧 以上，游戏先放到收藏夹里去了，等待游戏的后续更新

My son and I are addicted to this game. It is a lot of fun and the replay factor is fantastic. My only issue is that I would say the game crashes 1 out of 5 times that we play. I'm updating my review... This game locks up quite often now and resets completely. When it resets you lose all progress and you have to go through the tutorial again. I like the game but, there are quite a few negatives. Battles are boring since these nothing you can do to affect the outcome except click to trigger a spell every few seconds. Note that you have to set up a production lines for every spell. The maps are identical, except for small cosmetics. All enemies are the same with no different types of damage or resistance, and they all look very similar. There are many possible upgrades, but during a run you only get a few of them ( usually one or two after a battle) and those are often useless, since you simply don’t need or use them. There are many possible unit upgrades, but these are often not useful since you often lack the required resource or previous upgrade. The game will happily offer you a unit you cannot build because you don’t have that resource on the map. Like most of these kind of games, you are usually better producing more lower level units, than a few higher level ones, so the higher options don’t make much sense.
